activity.row: {who, select, me {You} other {{who}}} {action, select, expense_record {added an expense} refund_record {added a refund} expense_edit {changed an expense} expense_delete {deleted an expense} expense_restore {brought back a deleted expense} duplicate_same {said two expenses were the same purchase} duplicate_different {said two expenses were different purchases} month_close {closed a month} month_line_set {changed a month’s budget} checklist_skip {answered “not this month” on the checklist} pot_deposit {confirmed the pot deposit} pot_extra_in {put extra money in the pot} pot_taken_out {took money out of the pot} savings_confirm {confirmed a savings amount} year_line_amount {changed a yearly bill’s amount} year_line_schedule {changed a yearly bill’s month} year_line_done {marked a yearly bill done} year_line_cancel {dropped a yearly bill for this year} year_end_done {closed last year’s bill as done} year_end_drop {dropped last year’s bill} year_end_carry {moved last year’s bill into this year} year_plan_reviewed {confirmed next year’s bills} year_plan_first_year_check {answered the first-year check} item_added {added a template item} item_updated {changed a template item} item_archived {archived a template item} items_reordered {reordered template items} plan_imported {imported the family plan} family_created {created the family} member_joined {joined the family} other {made a change}}
